$comment: Release self-declaration consumed by the unified registry's auto-core-release resolver (sh2-plugin-registry/scripts/resolve-core-candidate.mjs) at the git tag being released, and by this repo's release-descriptor step. supports.core is the semver range of core (backend) versions this frontend works with; while the platform is pre-1.0, every 0.x minor is breaking, so widen/bump it deliberately. Raise the lower bound whenever a frontend feature starts depending on a newer backend feature (e.g. a new/changed /cms-api endpoint or field-naming contract): the floor 0.1.17 is the first core release that emits the UNPREFIXED style field names this frontend reads after the field-naming unification (backend migration Version20260622165615 drops the `shared_` prefix from 47 style props - `shared_color`->`color`, `shared_variant`->`variant`, `shared_radius`->`radius`, ...; reserved `shared_height`/`shared_width`/`shared_icon` keep their prefix). That 0.1.17 floor also carries everything the previous 0.1.15 floor required - the mobile-rendering taxonomy (style `renderTarget`, required field `scope` driving inspector grouping, the unprefixed-common/web_/mobile_ field split with `pages.id_platform` removed in favour of the page access type) PLUS the alert/badge/avatar/button/login authoring-polish field set (alert `closable`; button/badge `variant`; badge `circle`; avatar `name`; login `subtitle`). This frontend (0.1.30) reads the unprefixed names via @selfhelp/shared >=1.14.22 (the prefix drop), so it MUST NOT be paired with a pre-0.1.17 core that still emits `shared_*`; the resolver refuses any incompatible frontend+backend pair in either direction. v0.1.30 also adds the anonymous-preview guard for the core >=0.1.18 behavior (an anonymous `preview=true` is now rejected with 401): preview is gated on a live session cookie and `sh_preview` is cleared on logout/expiry. That guard is backward-safe on older cores, so the `supports.core` floor previously stayed at 0.1.17. v0.1.31 adds the page-editor Mobile Preview panel, which mints a one-time preview code through the protected BFF route `POST /api/mobile-preview/session` -> core `POST /cms-api/v1/admin/mobile-preview/session`. That admin mint endpoint (plus the public `POST /mobile-preview/session/exchange` and the `MobilePreviewAccessGuard` read allowlist) first ships in core 0.1.19, so this floor is raised 0.1.17 -> 0.1.19 (the panel degrades to a graceful 'unavailable' state on older cores, but the version contract tracks the dependency). v0.1.32 adds the System Maintenance 'Update / enable mobile preview' lane (GET/POST /cms-api/v1/admin/system/update/mobile-preview/{releases,preflight,request}) and reads the new `mobile_preview_version` field from /admin/system/version; those endpoints + field first ship in core 0.1.20, so this floor is raised 0.1.19 -> 0.1.20 (the UI degrades gracefully on an older core, but the version contract tracks the dependency). The resolver refuses any incompatible frontend+backend pair in either direction.
